traceability.notes: The ESLint plugin foundation described in 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP is fully implemented. The project exposes a TypeScript-based ESLint plugin with a central index that dynamically loads rule modules, provides recommended and strict flat-config presets, and integrates cleanly with ESLint v9 flat config (including CLI integration tests). Packaging (tsconfig and package.json) matches standard ESLint plugin conventions. Error handling for rule loading failures is implemented with a graceful fallback and verified by unit and CLI-level tests. Jest-based test infrastructure exists and is wired via package.json, with multiple tests tagged to this story explicitly validating plugin exports, rule registry contents, error handling, and CLI registration. README and supporting docs provide clear installation and configuration instructions for end users and development guidance for contributors. All acceptance criteria and enumerated requirements are therefore satisfied.
